chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn عليه السلام used to say to his steward:
If you intend to buy something for me from the needs of hajj, then buy it and do not bargain.

key_terms.تُمَاكِسْ: to haggle or bargain over price
key_terms.لِقَهْرَمَانِهِ: to his steward or household agent

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn عليه السلام teach about bargaining when buying hajj necessities?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn عليه السلام instructs his steward not to haggle when purchasing items needed for hajj. The report reflects dignified conduct and proper etiquette in transactions connected to acts of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3744 - Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain Zayn Al-Abidin (as) used to say to his steward:
"If you intend to buy something for me from the needs of Hajj, then buy it and do not bargain."
